title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.

title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’
summary: Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years. But this extended partnerships stretches beyond buying more chips.

title: Nvidia doubles revenue, forecasts even more AI spending
summary: AI juggernaut Nvidia on Wednesday reported quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, more than double from a year earlier, as the world's most valuable company beat Wall Street expectations and forecast even stronger sales ahead.Nvidia told investors to expect about $108 billion in revenue in the current quarter, well ahead of Wall Street forecasts and a signal that the company sees no near-term slowdown in AI spending.

title: Nvidia Rallies On Major Amazon Contract, Fiscal Q2 Beat-And-Raise Report
summary: Nvidia beat expectations for its fiscal Q2 and with its sales outlook. Nvidia stock rose after wavering after the report.

title: Amazon and Nvidia expand AI partnership with 2 million GPUs
summary: Investing.com -- Amazon Web Services and Nvidia announced today an expansion of their partnership to address growing demand for AI infrastructure. The companies plan to deploy 2 million additional Nvidia GPUs across AWS's global infrastructure in 2027-2028.

title: Investors Find More to Like on Nvidia’s Earnings Call
summary: After a tepid inital reaction, investors like what they're hearing on Nvidia's earnings call. CFO Colette Kress told analysts that the chip-maker projects 70% revenue growth in fiscal-year 2028, and that Amazon's AWS is deploying an additional 2 million Nvidia GPUs in the coming years.

title: Nvidia Announces Expanded Amazon Partnership on Earnings Call
summary: Nvidia announced an expanded partnership with cloud-computing giant Amazon on Wednesday. Amazon's AWS division "is deploying an addition two million GPUs starting this quarter through the second of FY29," Nvidia CFO Colette Kress said on a conference call after the chip giant's earnings report this afternoon.

title: Amazon to Buy 2 Million Nvidia Chips for Data Center Build-Out
summary: Amazon.com Inc. will add an additional 2 million Nvidia Corp. graphics processing units to its data center fleet in the next two years, a sign that the company remains committed to the AI hardware leader’s products despite its own competitive chipmaking efforts.
